basic_info.description: Discover the epitome of San Francisco luxury with Residence 56B, now available at an alluring new price. This corner retreat boasts breathtaking panoramic views, capturing the Bay Bridge, Treasure Island, and Berkeley hills. Spanning 2,226 square feet, this 2-bedroom and den and 2.5-bathroom sanctuary features exquisitely designed interiors, highlighted by French oak hardwood floors and a lavish primary bathroom adorned with Arabescato Corchia marble. The gourmet kitchen, outfitted with top-of-the-line Miele and Sub-Zero appliances, is a culinary enthusiast's dream. Designed by ODADA, this residence can be purchased fully furnished, embodying refined taste and timeless style. Thoughtful touches include custom closets by Polyform, Lutron solar shades throughout, and blackout shades in the bedrooms, seamlessly blending functionality with elegance. Beyond the allure of privacy & unrivaled views, 181 Fremont sets a new standard for luxury living with 5-star services, a world-class art program, & an exclusive Residents' Club. Enjoy the 360-degree open-air terrace, fireside gathering area, inviting lounges, state-of-the-art fitness center with a yoga studio. Notably, 181 Fremont offers direct access to Salesforce Park, a 5.4-acre oasis at your doorstep. Additional parking available.
